english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is subject to a definite cap or restriction.
Use this when a budget, supply, or other resource has little to spare.

examples.english: The amount each person can take is limited.
examples.jyutping: mui5 jan4 ho2 lo2 ge3 sou3 loeng6 jau5 haan6

examples.english: This month’s budget is lean, so we can’t spend money carelessly.
examples.traditional: 今個月預算有限，唔可以亂使錢。
examples.jyutping: gam1 go3 jyut6 jyu6 syun3 jau5 haan6 m4 ho2 ji5 lyun6 sai2 cin2
